description: Prompt for checking that a ticket's folder, branch, worktree, merge request and state history agree, for the grouped engines' health check: given its project's limits and seat holders, and reading its last script failure (ASS-240)

input-arguments.name: ticket-project
input-arguments.description: The project the ticket belongs to; the run itself is the harness project's

input-arguments.name: ticket-project-folder
input-arguments.description: That project's folder, by absolute path

input-arguments.name: seats
input-arguments.description: The ticket project's limits (project.json's, harness.json's; null for none) and seat holders, as control plans them (plan.js seatsOf): in-progress, in-planning and over-the-limits, each "<key> <variation>"

is-healthy.description: true if nothing about the ticket needs fixing

summary.description: What is wrong, or that all is well, in one line
